doc.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Prom night with Rusty Bryant and turning down the road
summary: She sat in on prom night, and Rusty came to her house to invite her on the road, but she chose college.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: So, on your prom night, you go to see Rusty. You sit it. You don’t remember what you sang, do you?
And he comes to the house . . .
It’s so much – you’re going to discover there’s an awful lot that I don’t – that I have not retained.
Rusty came to the house. He invited you to go on the road with him. Your parents probably would have allowed it.
But you had a different idea.

I said no. I was going to go to school. Since I had a scholarship, it would be foolish not to use it. And I wasn’t ready to – it still would have been close by. In fact I don’t think I ever went too far with Rusty’s band. We did not go out of the Midwest, really.
